answer: Mesa staking: each new agent must lock a small bond in a shared mesa pool and keep it there for a full voyage of ten epochs before its votes count. Peers who attest its work are tied by a thread of co-liability, so if the agent proves to be a sybil, both its bond and a slice of every voucher stake are slashed. Spinning up a thousand fakes means locking a thousand bonds for weeks and finding honest agents willing to risk theirs.
